proof.text: Reuse the proved integral_ramification helper of CompletedIntegralFiniteFree: the integer inclusion preserves absolute values, so the nonzero image of the source uniformizer is in the target maximal ideal. Factor it in the target DVR as a unit times the e-th power of the target uniformizer. The exponent is positive, since exponent zero would give a unit. Mapping the source principal ideal, discarding the unit factor, and rewriting the principal ideal of a power gives PurCompactSupport.Ramification for this e. This is a calculation with the existing integer inclusion; no ramification hypothesis is added.

Apply compactSupportCoefficientModels_scalar with that positive ramification exponent to M and its given finiteTorConstructibleIntegral proof. Its first conclusion says precisely that pbcDerivedExtend along completedCoefficientMap sends M to finiteTorConstructibleIntegral over F.

Apply scalar_refinement_origins_E with its coefficient field instantiated by F, its calculus by S′, and its input by the completed scalar extension of M, using the preceding integral finite-Tor constructibility proof. Its conclusion is definitionally the requested family of ScalarEtaleOrigin witnesses. Thus the single-field finite-origin argument is shared rather than repeated; no uniform lower bound or compatible choices of witnesses are asserted.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AK--09AL; strict scalar refinement auxiliary Step 1, realized by scalar preservation followed by the existing single-field origin theorem. Positive ramification uses the DVR calculation already proved in CompletedIntegralFiniteFree.

title: F-side origins for scalar refinement reductions
statement: For the finite-field and coefficient hypotheses of the strict scalar refinement, a coefficient calculus S' and an object M in finiteTorConstructibleIntegral have, independently at every n, a ScalarEtaleOrigin over the F reduction (ev F X n) ((reduction F X S').obj ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap i X)).obj M)).

lean.statement: theorem scalar_refinement_origins_F (S' : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l F X) (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (_hM : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X M) : ∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty (ScalarEtaleOrigin (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) X ((ev (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) X n).obj ((reduction l F X S').obj ((pbcDerivedExtend (completedCoefficientMap l E F i X)).obj M))))
